subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill configuration action metadata contract, and what URL/action policy should the dashboard enforce for skill-authored links?
rationale: This cannot be resolved as a narrow bug fix because the requested fields create a public SKILL.md metadata contract and a clickable dashboard trust boundary for third-party skill content.

options.title: Approve typed config action
options.body: Add a typed skill configuration action surface with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, default text, docs, and tests before rendering it in the dashboard.

options.title: Use existing surfaces only
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Cards, and ClawHub metadata as the supported discovery surfaces and decline separate configuration-link fields for now.

options.title: Defer to plugin settings API
options.body: Wait for a broader plugin/skill settings surface so configuration entry points are owned by one shared UI/action model instead of SKILL.md-specific fields.

recommendation.title: Approve typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a typed skill configuration action surface with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, default text, docs, and tests before rendering it in the dashboard.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available routing owner from the identified history because the decision spans skill metadata, dashboard URL policy, and product/security boundaries.
